description: This file defines the ClusterOptions class used for configuring an Orleans cluster, including default values and properties for ClusterId and ServiceId. It also includes a validation class, ClusterOptionsValidator, to ensure these options are correctly set.

classes.name: ClusterOptions
classes.description: Configuration class for Orleans cluster settings, including cluster ID and service ID with default values.

classes.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class to check the correctness of ClusterOptions' properties, ensuring non-empty ClusterId and ServiceId.

methods.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with provided options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method that validates ClusterOptions ensuring ClusterId and ServiceId are not null or whitespace.
